disclaimer: Curated defaults for new testers based on observed local verification, not a vendor benchmark. Free/local engines are preferred; a paid cloud engine (Sarvam) is recommended only where the free option is known to be broken or unreliable. Testers can still pick any installed/ready engine or voice per language in Settings.

inference.label: llama.cpp (local GGUF model)
inference.rationale: Free, local-first default with no per-call cost or cloud data exposure; verified across live sessions. Gemini/NVIDIA NIM remain opt-in paid cloud alternatives if higher multilingual fluency is needed.

stt.label: Nemotron (Parakeet ASR)
stt.rationale: Free, local engine, verified end-to-end on real English call audio.

tts.label: Lessac (Piper)
tts.rationale: Free, high-quality local Piper voice; no cloud dependency needed for English.

stt.label: Nemotron (Parakeet ASR)
stt.rationale: Free, local engine verified end-to-end on real Hindi call audio; no need for the paid Sarvam STT.

tts.label: Priyamvada (Piper)
tts.rationale: Free, local Piper voice confirmed working for Hindi; Sarvam Bulbul is a paid alternative if higher fidelity is needed.

stt.label: Sarvam STT
stt.rationale: Paid, used because the bundled free local sherpa/Whisper STT model fails on Bengali (empty transcripts).

tts.label: MMS Bengali Female (Sherpa)
tts.rationale: Free, local sherpa MMS voice; no known quality issue for Bengali TTS specifically (only STT is broken).

stt.label: Sarvam STT
stt.rationale: Paid, used because the bundled free local sherpa/Whisper STT model produces garbled Marathi output.

tts.label: MMS Marathi Female (Sherpa)
tts.rationale: Free, local sherpa MMS voice; no known quality issue for Marathi TTS specifically (only STT is affected).

stt.label: Sherpa (Whisper large-v3 int8)
stt.rationale: Free, local engine; not independently quality-verified but no known failure. Switch to Sarvam if transcription quality is insufficient in practice.

stt.label: Sherpa (Whisper large-v3 int8)
stt.rationale: Free, local engine verified to produce correct-script Tamil transcripts.

stt.label: Sarvam STT
stt.rationale: Paid, used because the bundled free local sherpa/Whisper STT model returns empty transcripts on Gujarati.

tts.label: MMS Gujarati Female (Sherpa)
tts.rationale: Free, local sherpa MMS voice confirmed working for Gujarati; no need for the paid Sarvam Bulbul voice.

stt.label: Sherpa (Whisper large-v3 int8)
stt.rationale: Free, local engine; not independently quality-verified but no known failure. Switch to Sarvam if transcription quality is insufficient in practice.
